run_server_shutdown_exception_test: run the gRPC server shutdown test scenario where the server raises an exception after starting
run_server_deallocated_test: run the gRPC server shutdown test scenario where the server is explicitly deallocated after starting
run_server_fork_exit_test: run the gRPC server shutdown test scenario where a forked child process exits during an RPC call
